Short answer
- Performance is worse this week-to-date (Mon–Wed) vs last week: net sales, orders and ad spend are each down ~27% per day and P&L net loss widened. The causal check found no single proven cause; lower orders and lower ad spend moved together and are the primary likely contributors. (Measured → Diagnoser labels below.)

Key evidence (Measured / Derived)
- Periods: Last week 2026-10-05..2026-10-11 (7 days) → This week-to-date 2026-10-12..2026-10-13 (2 days; 2026-10-14 partial excluded). (Measured)

- Orders totals: 339 → 71 (Measured). Per-day: 48.4 → 35.5, −26.7% (Derived).
- Ad spend totals: ₹430,735 → ₹88,998 (Measured). Per-day: ₹61,534 → ₹44,499, −27.6% (Derived).
- P&L net profit totals: −₹113,818 → −₹125,890 (Measured). Total increase in loss: −₹12,072 (Derived).

What the diagnoser reported (Measured labels kept)
- Exact decomposition shows the net-sales drop tied to a fall in P&L net sales / contribution margin and changes in return/cancel lines on 2026-10-12..13. (Measured)
- Drivers tested: Orders and Ad spend were outside their recent normal ranges and co-moved with sales; Ad spend is labelled a correlation / likely contributor by the causal tests (not a proved cause). Other levers (order value, returns, new customers, conversion rate) moved but the engine labelled them as describing the same events rather than a single upstream cause.
